description: Hash text or a file with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512, and compare against a hash you already have. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/hash-generator.

compareWith.description: A hash you have, to compare (optional)

fileContent.description: Or send a file as base64 (a data: URI is fine) instead of text

fileName.description: File name with extension, e.g. report.pdf

name: hash_generator
